Opus 5.5 made an anime trailer.

It downloaded the fonts, created the audio, and generated each frame using JavaScript.

This was one-shot. Cost $28 in API usage and took 1.5 hrs to create. I can only imagine the output with proper storyboarding. 

Prompt below. https://t.co/Kyo4lk5fts
